sampling.noise: independent zero-mean Gaussian real and imaginary components
sampling.seed_derivation: SHA256 of evaluation_seed:repetition:truth_id:operator:split; full digest as integer

inference.established_baseline: finite-library Gaussian weighted least squares in primitive species coordinates
inference.response_formulation: the same finite-library weighted least squares in mass-charge coordinates
inference.tie_rule: retain every minimizer within tolerance; first library index for prediction only
inference.information_policy: both formulations receive exactly the same observations, candidate library, operator, noise model and budget

scoring.primary: held-out mean squared residual divided by noise variance, per real component
scoring.paired_advantage: (baseline score - response score) / baseline score; first average six truths within each repetition
scoring.uncertainty: mean +/- 1.99834 times sample standard error over 64 independent repetition aggregates; approximate two-sided 95% Student interval
scoring.recovery_uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval over repetitions, reported separately for each fixed truth and operator
scoring.allowed_null: ties, unresolved parameter classes and no comparative gain are valid scientific outcomes
scoring.utility_claim: UNESTABLISHED: coordinate re-expression is not a distinct inference method

required: mass-only charge-scale invisibility at zero mixing

harness_failure: overlapping split points or reused split seeds
scientific_failure: failure to resolve a parameter class
failure_policy.post_evaluation_change: substantive changes require a new candidate/run; reused cases become regression evidence
